title: MCP Tool Review
summary: When an MCP server changes a tool you approved, shows the word-by-word diff and highlights poisoned instructions before the agent uses it.
description: Review card for MCP tool changes after approval: fingerprints each definition, diffs the description word by word, marks injected instructions (<IMPORTANT> blocks, "do not tell the user", ~/.ssh, other servers' tools), new free-text parameters and flipped read-only hints.
catches: Tool definitions changed since approval (fingerprint mismatch)
Injected instructions such as <IMPORTANT> blocks or "do not tell the user"
References to secrets or config such as ~/.ssh and mcp.json, or to another server's tools
New free-text parameters that could carry data out
Invisible characters and read-only annotations that flipped
limits: Phrase-based detection; a reworded injection can slip through
Only sees definitions the host passes in; it doesn't talk to MCP servers
Keep, disable or accept is passed to onResolve; enforcing it is the host's job
a11y: Each tool card expands with aria-expanded and aria-controls
Focus moves to the open card's first action
Risk is shown in text with icons aria-hidden
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
server: Pin approved tool definitions in the MCP host and refuse calls to tools whose fingerprint changed until re-approved.
stops: Helps catch an MCP server swapping in poisoned tools
